notes:
Summary: Porchlight Spark is a mid-market SaaS (b2b support platform) evaluating Redwood starting with Hosted API. After the hosted demo they requested Dedicated for predictable latency and tenant isolation. Current plan: 3-week Dedicated POC. POC objectives: validate p99 latency under 95th percentile SLA, verify automatic fallback to hosted API under overload, validate KV cache warmup for chat history, and exercise model variant routing for cost tradeoffs.

Key requirements / quotes: "We need sub-300ms median and sub-800ms p99 for short-turn support prompts at baseline traffic" — Head of Product. Must have SSO/SAML and audit logs; retention controls for transcripts (30–90 days). KMS integration mandatory.

POC technical approach (agreed):
- Environment: Dedicated pool in us-east-1 with VPC peering to Porchlight infra; secondary canary region eu-west-1 for failover testing.
- Canary plan: start with 5% production traffic to Dedicated pool routed by feature-flagged endpoint. Monitor latency, error rate, cost per 1M tokens. After 48h of stable metrics (no >10% increase in error rate and p99 within SLA), increase to 25% then 50% then 100% over 6–8 days.
- Model variants: primary = redwood-compat-xl (quantized variant for Dedicated); fallback variant = redwood-compat-medium (cheaper, lower throughput) for cost-constrained bursts; hosted fallback = Redwood Hosted-compat-xl in us-east as last resort. Routing rules: prefer Dedicated primary; if Dedicated queue > 3s or error rate >2% for 5m, route to hosted fallback or downgraded model depending on load.
- Region failover: if us-east suffers degraded performance (p99 > 1200ms for 10m or sustained GPU OOMs), shift traffic to eu-west canary pool with gradual ramp and evaluate latency impact.
- Rollback criteria: any regression in semantic quality (customer eval score drop >5 pts on test set) OR unexplained increase in error-rate >3% OR security incident. Rollback triggers immediate shift of traffic back to Hosted API and pause rollout.

Success metrics for POC:
- p99 latency <= 800ms on customer test harness for 95% of runs
- Error rate < 1% for generation calls
- Cost per 1M tokens within 20% of Dedicated quote target after batching configs
- KV cache hit rate >= 65% for chat flows
- Verified SSO/KMS integration and audit logging to customer SIEM
